text:
oliver: CI alert — staging p99 up ~12% after merge of commit c3d4e5f. Noticed oscillation in batcher and repeated kernel hops in nsys timeline. Traces uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/staging/3312345678/{before,after}.nsys
sarah: repro steps?
oliver: run the nightly perf harness: `./scripts/perf/run_trace.sh --model=gpt-small --seq=2048 --tokens=8 --iters=200 --profile nsight` I used: `nsys profile --trace=nvtx,cuda,osrt -o out_after ./bin/infer --conf conf/staging.json`
kai: timeline shows frequent memcpy peaks and fallback to slow_kernel at each batch boundary. stack shows `cudaMemcpyAsync` dominating between kernels. looks like selector toggles kernels every 30ms.
devin: can you paste the nvtx timeline snippet or the kernel timeline text? also what's the batcher config? maybe adaptive window changed.
oliver: pasted snippet:
```
Kernel timeline (after):
0ms  fast_kernel  1.2ms
1.5  memcpyAsync  0.9ms
2.5  slow_kernel  1.8ms
4.5  memcpyAsync  1.0ms
```
Batcher config in staging: `adaptive_batcher.max_inflight=32`, `warmup_prefill=8`, `route_policy=latency` (was 64 before PR)
jen: IIRC PR #432 tweaked inflight default. pinging perf-bot for CI compare :eyes: 
perf-bot: CI trace compare: p50 +3.1%, p95 +8.7%, p99 +12.4%. Notable: memcpy time increased from 1.1ms -> 2.6ms median between kernels. Linked diffs: https://ci.redwood/compare/3312345678
devin: hypothesis: reducing max_inflight caused smaller batches and more frequent kernel swaps, which forces KV rebinds and memcpy churn. Try reverting max_inflight to 64 for a canary.
kai: also saw kernel selector changed in runtime tree. snippet from commit c3d4e5f:
```
if (profile.seq_len > 1536 || load_factor > 0.8) {
  choose(slow_kernel);
} else {
  choose(fast_kernel);
}
```
maybe seq_len threshold moved down to 1536 causing mismatch for our 2048 runs.
oliver: ran experiment: reverted inflight to 64 and pinned selector threshold to 2048 locally. result: p99 back within 2% of baseline. Created bisect range for PRs 420..440 to find exact culprit.
devin: plan: run bisect script: `./scripts/perf/bisect_commits.sh --range 420..440 --harness scripts/perf/run_trace.sh --model gpt-small --seq 2048` will upload traces automatically.
jen: add perfetto snapshots and nvtx annotations so we can show oncall and docs. also open ticket to rollback or patch.
perf-bot: bisect complete — regression introduced in commit c3d4e5f (PR #432). Metrics: p99 +12.4, memcpy spikes correlate with kernel selection changes. Ticket RED-1542 opened.
sarah: thanks everyone. can we do a canary rollout with inflight=64 and selector threshold=2048 on 10% of traffic and monitor? tag SRE.
oliver: done — canary config pushed, monitoring dash linked: https://grafana.redwood/d/flow/3312345678
kai: note for follow-up: add unit test for selector stability and a perf test guarding p99 on long sequences. :+1:
